mean_post_open_weight_columns: Fields named mean_post_open_*_weight in period_component_summary.csv are post-open USD holdings divided by the previous period USD NAV for additive arithmetic attribution, not contemporaneous post-open portfolio weights.
cash_opportunity_log: Minus that cash-to-prior-NAV ratio times the full matching SOXX reference return, scaled to paired log difference; descriptive accounting term, not a causal cash-policy effect.
SOXL_selection_log: Actual SOXL physical segment return contribution minus post-open SOXL-to-prior-NAV exposure times full matching SOXX reference return, scaled to paired log difference; relative exposure accounting, not demonstrated predictive selection skill.
residual_log: Algebraic remainder includes intraday timing, benchmark cash/fee/corporate conventions and other denominator differences; exact component-log closure is by construction. Independent physical check is holdings_attribution native daily return closure.
residual_absolute_ratio_denominator: sum(abs(daily paired SOXX relative log return))
